verdict.rationale: Bugbot reads `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files committed to the repository for project-specific review guidelines, which gives a versioned, in-repo place for review instructions. Verbose runs report which rules were loaded. The rest of the story is thin. The plural 'files' only implies per-directory or per-path instructions. Effort levels and org-wide rules appear to be set through billing settings and the Automations dashboard, not a repo config file. Missing for 10: documented path include/exclude filters, explicit per-path instruction scoping, review profiles defined in a repo config file, and independent hands-on corroboration of the BUGBOT.md workflow.
